Text: How a category score (0-100) is calculated
Calculation: category_score = ROUND( (SUM of every scored question's contribution ÷ number of scored questions) × 100 ).  Each contribution is 0 (best) to 1 (worst) — see the per-question Calculation column below for how each one is computed. Informational-only questions are left out of both the sum and the count.

Text: How the overall score (0-100) is calculated
Calculation: overall_score = ROUND( average of all 10 category scores ).  Every category counts equally regardless of how many questions it has.

Text: Risk tier thresholds
Calculation: Low = 0-33  |  Moderate = 34-66  |  High = 67-100 (applies to both category scores and the overall score)
